query: UPDATE tasks t1 SET t1.`order` = (SELECT COUNT(*) - 1 FROM tasks t2 WHERE t2.userId = t1.userId AND t2.category = t1.category AND DATE(t2.dueDate) = DATE(t1.dueDate) AND t2.id <= t1.id) WHERE t1.userId = 1 AND DATE(t1.dueDate) = '2026-03-30'
